li:
AI chatbots are easy to demo and hard to get right.

Before signing, we'd ask any vendor five questions:

1. Where do its answers come from? \(Your documents, with the source shown.\)
2. What happens when it doesn't know? \(It should hand over to a person, not guess.\)
3. Where does our data go? \(Storage, access, model training. In writing.\)
4. How will we know it's working? \(Agree the measure before launch.\)
5. Who keeps it up to date? \(Content goes stale faster than people expect.\)

If you've been quoted for one and want a second opinion, send it over: https://xenovasolutions.com/contact
